listing.name: Guitar Hero II (plus classic Harmonix song imports) — Guitar Hero Classic (noahbaxter)
listing.summary: Upstream publishes preview packages for Windows x86-64, Linux x86-64 and Apple Silicon. Use your own USA Guitar Hero II disc image for setup. Additional original Guitar Hero discs are optional imports.

steps.title: Check the required game files
steps.instruction: Use your own USA PlayStation 2 Guitar Hero II disc (SLUS-21447) as an ISO, CHD or BIN. Other original Guitar Hero discs are optional imports.

steps.title: Set up the Windows or Linux package
steps.instruction: Extract the ZIP and put the disc image in PUT_DISC_HERE beside the game.

steps.title: Set up the Apple Silicon package
steps.instruction: Open the disk image and drag GHClassic to Applications. Run it once to open the PUT_DISC_HERE folder in ~/Library/Application Support/GHClassic. Put your disc image there.

warnings: This release uses a disc-folder setup and remains in development. GHClassic is not confirmed to be the same project as Recomp-Hero-2; use the instructions for this implementation.
Portcove has not confirmed setup, gameplay, saves or updates for this experimental port.

restrictions.explanation: Portcove has identified the upstream v0.9 game packages. Package acquisition remains on hold until their contents and permission to use them through Portcove are reviewed.
